 Jarred Vanderbilt has played his way back to Lakers relevancy 
 It looks like Vando is out of JJ Redick's doghouse for the near future. By Svyatoslav Rovenchuk | Nov 16, 2026, 12:51 PM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Feb 1, 2024; Boston, Massachusetts, USA; Los Angeles Lakers forward Jarred Vanderbilt (2) reacts after a play against then Boston Celtics in the first quarter at TD Garden. Mandatory Credit: David Butler II-USA TODAY Sports | USA TODAY Sports via Reuters Connect From bad contract to bad news for opponents, Jarred Vanderbilt has made the most of the opportunities he has been given to make an impact off the bench for the Los Angeles Lakers. After not playing in the first four games of the season, Vando has appeared in nine of the last 10.
--> From bad contract to bad news for opponents, Jarred Vanderbilt has made the most of the opportunities he has been given to make an impact off the bench for the Los Angeles Lakers. After not playing in the first four games of the season, Vando has appeared in nine of the last 10.
 That fact stood out in particular during the Lakers' most recent 131-123 win over the Phoenix Suns. Los Angeles only played nine guys in that contest. Vanderbilt made the cut as the ninth man.
--> That fact stood out in particular during the Lakers' most recent 131-123 win over the Phoenix Suns. Los Angeles only played nine guys in that contest. Vanderbilt made the cut as the ninth man.
 Part of that was undoubtedly the available minutes caused by Austin Reaves' absence , sure. However, Vanderbilt got the nod over Adou Thiero, who was a DNP against the Suns. Even if part of that is chalked up to Thiero (left ankle sprain) being a late upgrade from questionable to available, it still speaks to the trust JJ Redick has regained in Vando.
--> Part of that was undoubtedly the available minutes caused by Austin Reaves' absence , sure. However, Vanderbilt got the nod over Adou Thiero, who was a DNP against the Suns. Even if part of that is chalked up to Thiero (left ankle sprain) being a late upgrade from questionable to available, it still speaks to the trust JJ Redick has regained in Vando.
 Instead of forcing a slightly hobbled Adou to play, Redick was comfortable turning to his veteran forward instead. Vanderbilt was mostly effective in his 12 minutes during the Suns game, too. As the Lakers navigate injuries and a backup center problem, Vando should continue to have a chance to step on the court with reasonable consistency.

As the Lakers navigate injuries and a backup center problem, Vando should continue to have a chance to step on the court with reasonable consistency.
 Jarred Vanderbilt has become playable for the Lakers once more
--> Jarred Vanderbilt has become playable for the Lakers once more
 Redick has iced Vanderbilt out in the past. That is not to blame the Lakers coach either. Those decisions made sense. Previously, the lack of offensive potency from his high-energy forward made it tough to feature him on a team that was constructed in a much different manner.
--> Redick has iced Vanderbilt out in the past. That is not to blame the Lakers coach either. Those decisions made sense. Previously, the lack of offensive potency from his high-energy forward made it tough to feature him on a team that was constructed in a much different manner.
 Skip ahead to this season and the Lakers have more offensive firepower on the roster. It makes it easier to get Vanderbilt on the floor and have his strengths shine above his weaknesses . 
--> Skip ahead to this season and the Lakers have more offensive firepower on the roster. It makes it easier to get Vanderbilt on the floor and have his strengths shine above his weaknesses . 
 His counting stats do not tell the story with justice, but the energy on the glass and defensive end have stood out to anyone watching. Vanderbilt is far from perfect as a player. However, in the areas he is supposed to be good at, Vando is delivering.

 Sandro Mamukelashvili
 has been the key to Jarred Vanderbilt's revival
--> Sandro Mamukelashvili
 has been the key to Jarred Vanderbilt's revival
 One of the ideas floated during the summer around here was that Vanderbilt could pair well for minutes with Sandro Mamukelashvili in the frontcourt. It just made sense. The two covered up for each other's shortcomings quite well in theory. In practice, that has been the case so far.
--> One of the ideas floated during the summer around here was that Vanderbilt could pair well for minutes with Sandro Mamukelashvili in the frontcourt. It just made sense. The two covered up for each other's shortcomings quite well in theory. In practice, that has been the case so far.
 It is a small sample size, but the two-man combination of Vanderbilt and Mamukelashvili has played well. The lineup data has the pair posting a net rating of 14.4 in their 97 minutes together. That includes an offensive rating of 119.2 and a defensive rating of 104.8.
--> It is a small sample size, but the two-man combination of Vanderbilt and Mamukelashvili has played well. The lineup data has the pair posting a net rating of 14.4 in their 97 minutes together. That includes an offensive rating of 119.2 and a defensive rating of 104.8.
 For Redick, who loves numbers and recently audited the Lakers , those metrics are sure to stand out. As long as the make-up of this roster is what it is, Vanderbilt should get an opportunity to play a role. Even if those doses of minutes are small and can involve skipping a night or two, they will be there.
